name: 28562 · New Bern, NC
findings: ZIP 28562 (New Bern) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28562 (New Bern) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28562 (New Bern) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
